claim: On host macos-m5pro-20260924 (Apple M5 Pro, Mac17,8, macOS 26.5.1 build 25F80, arm64), the second physical machine, the Alpaca paper lane ran end to end through the adaptive NautilusTrader 2.0.0rc5 engine with alpaca-py 0.44.0, in hash-locked CPython 3.12.14 runtimes (the #176 engine lock and the promotion-gate lock). The 732 adaptive-paper tests (one skip by design) and 17 native-faults offline tests passed. A live read-only runner preflight reported ready on the paper endpoint. The committed 2026-09-24 artifacts, re-checked offline by verify_artifacts.py, show: a 300 s 1x SIP one-share trial from a frozen 6f7a77c archive (33 submits, 3 cancel-replaces, 30 native fills in 15 round trips, reconciled flat, realized -1.51 USD); a STOP drill in which a working entry was canceled unfilled 115 ms after STOP, with no order after it and recover flat; and the native-faults harness (C01 and C02 native_paper; C05 engine short-circuit; C04 unobserved).
limitations: The paper trial, STOP drill, recover and native-faults runs executed once on this host earlier in the same session (2026-09-24 14:23-14:32Z) from a read-only git archive of main 6f7a77c. The verify_artifacts.py command here re-checks their committed outputs offline; it is not a new broker run. Only the preflight command contacted the broker when this receipt was recorded (read-only, no orders).
Paper only: no live endpoint was used. Alpaca paper fills are simulated. One 5-minute window with 1-share orders at 1x is not evidence of strategy edge, broker throughput or live readiness.

Recorded outside Claude Code's Seatbelt sandbox, which denies the credential-store read, broker network access and the loopback bind that 3 metrics tests need. macOS has no GNU timeout, so scheduled_trial.sh ran unchanged with a stdlib stand-in (trials/mac-2026-09-24-a-passed/macos_timeout.py).

The paper account is shared with other hosts, and the engine's account lock is host-local. Native evidence for fault cases C04 and C05 is blocked on unmerged PR #169; plan.json defines no C03. The STOP drill did not exercise an exit under STOP (the entry never filled), a restart with STOP present, or a failed cancel.

The one test skip is by design (exchange_calendars is not in the engine runtime). The 42 unchanged upstream adapter tests, the full repository suite in this runtime and the bwrap network-namespaced engine replay were not run.
